name: Greedy Meshing with Occlusion Culling
definition: A meshing algorithm that converts voxel data into optimized quads by grouping contiguous voxels of the same material on each face, while using bitwise occlusion masks to cull faces hidden by other geometry.
summary: Greedy Meshing with Occlusion Culling converts voxel data into optimized quads by grouping contiguous voxels while using pre-computed bitwise occlusion masks to cull hidden faces, differing from standard greedy meshing by avoiding neighbor checks during the sweep.
